maddeler.e:
تكافأت (form VI)
# تَكَافَأْتُ (takāfaʔtu) /ta.kaː.faʔ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَكَافَأَ (takāfaʔa)
# تَكَافَأْتَ (takāfaʔta) /ta.kaː.faʔ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَكَافَأَ (takāfaʔa)
# تَكَافَأْتِ (takāfaʔti) /ta.kaː.faʔ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَكَافَأَ (takāfaʔa)
# تَكَافَأَتْ (takāfaʔat) /ta.kaː.fa.ʔat/: third-person fem
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
